title: Three Months and One Short Ledger
subtitle: 经济金融 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济金融（人与社会·经济与金融）
meta: 主题语境：经济金融（人与社会·经济与金融）　|　核心词汇：finance　|　正文 337 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 finance 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 the banker ① managed the finance that no clerk in the bank would have counted, and he said the managing was the whole of the spring. The ② finance, meaning the money itself and not the account, ran three months and stayed uncounted in the book; finance, he said, is the only thing in a bank that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ item of finance in that bank had the same short ledger beside it, and the ④ finance at the far counter, meaning the part they kept for the shop and not either of those, was the only part anybody ever thanked twice. Finance, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the banker said the counting is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the finance was the whole of the matter, meaning the funding and not the money. The ⑥ finance, meaning the funding and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; finance, he said, is either something you manage or the only word that means both money and funding. He said the funding is the part they remember.

By 1973 the ⑦ finance had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short ledger. The ⑧ finance of the whole thing, the banker wrote in April, was one bank and three months of counting; finance, he said, is either the part at the far counter or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ finance I remember is the part written in the plan, which closed in 1975 and is still described as the quietest in the bank. ⑩ Finance, my mother said in 1977, is the only thing that improves by being counted; all finance, she said, is funding that has agreed to look like money. She said the funding was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 财务；资金（指银行里每一笔旁边的那一笔）
B. n. 资金（指那笔本身，与账户相对）
C. 固定搭配：manage the finance 掌管财务
D. n. 资金（指留给店铺的那一部分）
E. n. 财务（抽象总称，指一家银行的理财之事）
F. n. 资金（指计划里写到、被清点的那一部分）
G. n. 资金筹措；融资（指一件事里人人都等却无人清点的那样东西）
H. n. 融资（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人清点的那样东西）

items.q: managed the finance that no clerk in the bank would have counted
The finance, meaning the money itself and not the account
Every item of finance in that bank
the finance at the far counter
the finance was the whole of the matter
the finance had become a line in a plan
The finance of the whole thing

answers.why: manage the finance 意为“掌管财务”，1966 年那位银行家掌管了银行里没有一位职员肯清点的财务。
finance 意为“资金”，指那笔本身而不是账户，它经过了三个月而在簿子上没有被清点。
finance 意为“财务、资金”，指银行里每一笔旁边的那一笔，每一笔旁边都有同一本短短的账簿。
finance 意为“资金”，指留给店铺的那一部分，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
finance 意为“资金筹措、融资”，指一件事里人人都等却无人清点的那样东西，叔叔说这笔融资就是那件事的全部。
finance 意为“融资”，指人人都等却无人清点的那样东西而不是那笔资金，是事情里人人都等、却无人清点的东西。
finance 意为“资金”，指计划里写到、被清点的那一部分，到 1973 年这一笔成了计划里的一行。
finance 意为“财务”，银行家四月写道，整件事的理财之事是一家银行和三个月的清点。
finance 意为“资金”，我记得的是计划里写下的那一部分，1975 年结束了，至今仍被说成银行里最安静的一部分。
finance 为抽象总称，母亲 1977 年说，财务是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的东西。
